title: URLs with an ampersand are escaped in the wrong places
body: Bugs seen in mistune: (1) with the fenced image directive, '~~~{image} https://example.com/picture.png?foo=qux&test=me' and a ':target: https://example.com/rickroll?a=1&b=2' option do not produce valid HTML: the ampersand in the img src and in the link href must appear as &. (2) With renderer=None (the AST), a link '[hi &<>"](https://example.com/foo?a=1&b=2)' has its url attribute altered by HTML escaping; the AST must carry the url exactly as written.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=src mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
